meta.title: BC Jurisprudence Question Bank
meta.disclaimer: Unofficial practice questions based on public legislation (Emergency Health Services Act RSBC 1996 c.182; EMA Regulation B.C. Reg. 210/2010; BC Provincial Examination Guidelines June 2026). Verify against current law at bclaws.gov.bc.ca

questions.questionEn: Who licenses emergency medical assistants (EMAs) in British Columbia?
questions.questionZh: 在 BC 省，谁负责给 emergency medical assistant (EMA) 发牌？

options.textEn: The Canadian Organization of Paramedic Regulators (COPR)
options.textZh: 加拿大护理员监管组织（COPR）

options.textEn: The College of Physicians and Surgeons of BC
options.textZh: BC 内外科医生学院（College of Physicians and Surgeons of BC）

options.textEn: The Emergency Medical Assistants Licensing Board
options.textZh: Emergency Medical Assistants Licensing Board（EMA 发牌委员会）

options.textEn: British Columbia Emergency Health Services (BCEHS)
options.textZh: British Columbia Emergency Health Services (BCEHS)

questions.explanationEn: The Emergency Medical Assistants Licensing Board is continued under s.6(1) of the Emergency Health Services Act and has the power to examine, register and license EMAs (s.6(5)(a)). BCEHS is the service-delivery corporation, and COPR only administers the PCP entry-to-practice written exam.
questions.explanationZh: EHS Act s.6(1) 设立（延续）了 Emergency Medical Assistants Licensing Board，其法定职权包括对 EMA 进行考试、注册和发牌（s.6(5)(a)）。BCEHS 是提供服务的机构，COPR 只是主持 PCP entry-to-practice 笔试的组织。

questions.questionEn: Which statement about the composition of the EMA Licensing Board is correct?
questions.questionZh: 关于 EMA Licensing Board 的组成，下列哪项正确？

options.textEn: It has 3 members, one of whom must be an EMA and another a medical practitioner, appointed by the Lieutenant Governor in Council
options.textZh: 由 3 名成员组成，其中一名必须是 EMA、另一名必须是执业医生，由省督（Lieutenant Governor in Council）任命

options.textEn: Its members are appointed by BCEHS
options.textZh: 成员由 BCEHS 任命

options.textEn: All members must be medical practitioners
options.textZh: 所有成员都必须是执业医生

options.textEn: It has 5 members elected by licensed paramedics
options.textZh: 由持牌护理员选举产生的 5 名成员组成

questions.explanationEn: EHS Act s.6(2): the licensing board is composed of 3 members, one of whom must be an emergency medical assistant selected in the prescribed manner and another of whom must be a medical practitioner, appointed by the Lieutenant Governor in Council.
questions.explanationZh: EHS Act s.6(2)：licensing board 由 3 名成员组成，其中一名必须是按规定方式选出的 EMA，另一名必须是执业医生（medical practitioner），由省督任命。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following is NOT a requirement for an initial EMA licence under s.2 of the EMA Regulation?
questions.questionZh: 根据 EMA Regulation s.2，下列哪项不是首次申领 EMA licence 的必要条件？

options.textEn: Successful completion of a training program recognized by the licensing board
options.textZh: 成功完成 licensing board 认可的培训课程

options.textEn: Passing the board-approved examinations within the required time
options.textZh: 在规定时间内通过 Board 批准的考试

options.textEn: A minimum of two years of residency in British Columbia
options.textZh: 在 BC 省居住满两年

options.textEn: Evidence of good character and fitness to work as an EMA
options.textZh: 品行良好且适合从事 EMA 工作的证明

questions.explanationEn: EMA Regulation s.2(1)(c) requires evidence of (i) completing recognized training, (ii) passing approved examinations no later than 12 months after completing training, and (iii) good character and fitness to work as an EMA. There is no residency requirement.
questions.explanationZh: EMA Regulation s.2(1)(c) 要求提供的证据是：(i) 完成认可培训；(ii) 在完成培训后 12 个月内通过批准的考试；(iii) 品行良好且适合从事 EMA 工作。法规里没有任何居住年限要求。

questions.questionEn: A candidate completed their recognized training program on June 1. Under the EMA Regulation, by when must they normally pass the board-approved licensing examinations?
questions.questionZh: 某考生于 6 月 1 日完成认可培训课程。根据 EMA Regulation，正常情况下他必须在何时之前通过 Board 批准的发牌考试？

options.textEn: There is no time limit
options.textZh: 没有时间限制

options.textEn: Within 24 months of completing the training program
options.textZh: 完成培训后 24 个月内

options.textEn: Within 6 months of completing the training program
options.textZh: 完成培训后 6 个月内

options.textEn: Within 12 months of completing the training program
options.textZh: 完成培训后 12 个月内

questions.explanationEn: EMA Regulation s.2(1)(c)(ii): examinations must be passed no later than 12 months after the date the person completed the training program. If extraordinary circumstances prevented this, the board may extend the period by up to a further 6 months (s.2(2)).
questions.explanationZh: EMA Regulation s.2(1)(c)(ii)：必须在完成培训课程后 12 个月内通过考试。如因特殊情况（extraordinary circumstances）无法完成，Board 可再延长最多 6 个月（s.2(2)）。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following correctly describes the BC jurisprudence examination?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项正确描述了 BC 的 jurisprudence 考试？

options.textEn: 25 questions, no time limit, 80% to pass
options.textZh: 25 道题，不限时，80% 及格

options.textEn: 100 questions, no time limit, 80% to pass
options.textZh: 100 道题，不限时，80% 及格

options.textEn: 25 questions, 1 hour time limit, 70% to pass
options.textZh: 25 道题，限时 1 小时，70% 及格

options.textEn: 50 questions, 2 hours, 75% to pass
options.textZh: 50 道题，2 小时，75% 及格

questions.explanationEn: The Provincial Examination Guidelines state the jurisprudence examination consists of 25 questions with no time limit, and 80% is required to pass. It is required for all licensing candidates at the EMR, PCP, ITT, ACP and CCP levels.
questions.explanationZh: 省考试指南规定：jurisprudence 考试共 25 题、不限时、80% 及格。EMR、PCP、ITT、ACP、CCP 所有级别的发牌考生都必须通过。

questions.questionEn: A candidate fails the jurisprudence examination twice. What happens next?
questions.questionZh: 某考生 jurisprudence 考试连续两次不及格，接下来会怎样？

options.textEn: They must complete a new training program before any further attempt
options.textZh: 必须先重读新的培训课程才能再考

options.textEn: They must wait 5 days before a third and final attempt
options.textZh: 必须等 5 天才能进行第三次、也是最后一次尝试

options.textEn: They may re-attempt immediately at any time
options.textZh: 可以随时立即重考

options.textEn: They must wait 30 days before a third attempt
options.textZh: 必须等 30 天才能进行第三次尝试

questions.explanationEn: Per the Exam Guidelines, after a first failure the jurisprudence exam may be re-attempted at any time; after a second failure the candidate must wait 5 days before the third and final attempt. Only after three failed attempts is a new training program required.
questions.explanationZh: 按考试指南：第一次不及格可随时重考；第二次不及格必须等 5 天才能进行第三次、也是最后一次尝试。只有三次都失败后才需要重读新培训课程。

questions.questionEn: A candidate has failed a required examination three times. To become eligible to begin the exam process again, they must:
questions.questionZh: 某考生某门必考科目已三次不及格。要重新获得考试资格，他必须：

options.textEn: Pay a re-examination fee of $450
options.textZh: 缴纳 $450 重考费

options.textEn: Appeal to the Supreme Court
options.textZh: 向最高法院上诉

options.textEn: Wait 12 months and then re-register
options.textZh: 等 12 个月后重新报名

options.textEn: Submit proof of successful completion of a new recognized training program
options.textZh: 提交成功完成新的认可培训课程的证明

questions.explanationEn: The Exam Guidelines state candidates have three attempts at each required examination; candidates unsuccessful after three attempts must submit proof of successful completion of a new recognized training program to be eligible to begin the exam process again.
questions.explanationZh: 考试指南规定：每门必考科目有三次机会；三次不及格者必须提交完成新的认可培训课程的证明，才能重新开始考试流程。

questions.questionEn: After failing the practical exams 3 times and completing a new training program, a candidate can be exempt from rewriting the written and/or jurisprudence exams only if:
questions.questionZh: 实操考试三次不及格并重读新课程后，考生要豁免重考笔试和/或 jurisprudence 考试，条件是：

options.textEn: The exams were completed within 6 months of finishing the new program AND the candidate scored 85% or higher on the first attempt
options.textZh: 这些考试是在完成新课程后 6 个月内考的，且第一次尝试就拿到 85% 或以上

options.textEn: The training provider recommends the exemption
options.textZh: 培训机构出具豁免推荐

options.textEn: The candidate scored at least 80% on any attempt
options.textZh: 任意一次尝试拿到至少 80%

options.textEn: The exams were completed within 12 months of the new program, regardless of score
options.textZh: 在新课程后 12 个月内考过即可，不看分数

questions.explanationEn: Per the Exam Guidelines, the exemption applies only when the written and/or jurisprudence exams were completed within 6 months of successfully completing the new training program AND the candidate received 85% or higher on the first attempt.
questions.explanationZh: 按考试指南：豁免的条件是笔试和/或 jurisprudence 考试在成功完成新培训课程后 6 个月内完成，且第一次尝试就拿到 85% 或以上，两个条件缺一不可。

questions.questionEn: An applicant licensed in another province applies for a BC licence under s.3 of the EMA Regulation. Which circumstance would mean the applicant is NOT 'in good standing' in that other jurisdiction?
questions.questionZh: 一名在其他省份持牌的申请人依 EMA Regulation s.3 申请 BC licence。下列哪种情形会使其不属于在原管辖区 'in good standing'（信誉良好）？

options.textEn: They voluntarily let their registration lapse when moving for family reasons
options.textZh: 因家庭原因搬家而自愿让注册失效

options.textEn: They are the subject of a pending hearing relating to a patient-care complaint
options.textZh: 正因患者照护投诉（patient-care complaint）面临待审听证

options.textEn: They completed their training more than 5 years ago
options.textZh: 完成培训已超过 5 年

options.textEn: They have never worked in British Columbia
options.textZh: 从未在 BC 省工作过

questions.explanationEn: Under s.3(1), 'in good standing' requires that the applicant is not the subject of an investigation, pending hearing, hearing underway or pending decision relating to any patient-care complaint, has no complaint-based conditions or restrictions, and has not resigned or been suspended for incompetence, incapacity or misconduct. Leaving practice for unrelated personal reasons does not offend the definition.
questions.explanationZh: s.3(1) 规定 'in good standing' 要求：没有正在进行的患者照护投诉调查、待审听证或待决定事项；没有因投诉被施加条件或限制；也没有因不胜任、能力丧失或不当行为而辞职弃牌或被暂停。因与执业能力无关的个人原因离开执业不影响该定义。

questions.questionEn: The licensing board decides an out-of-province applicant's training is not fully equivalent to BC requirements. What may the board require?
questions.questionZh: licensing board 认定某省外申请人的培训与 BC 要求不完全等效。Board 可以要求什么？

options.textEn: Nothing — the application must simply be refused
options.textZh: 什么都不能要求——只能直接拒绝申请

options.textEn: Examinations or training covering only the matters not considered equivalent
options.textZh: 只覆盖不等效部分的考试或培训

options.textEn: The applicant must repeat an entire BC training program in all cases
options.textZh: 申请人一律必须重读完整的 BC 培训课程

options.textEn: Two years of supervised practice in BC
options.textZh: 在 BC 接受两年监督执业

questions.explanationEn: EMA Regulation s.3(3): the board may require examinations or training programs before issuing the licence, but in choosing them it must cover only matters for which the other jurisdiction's examinations or training are not considered equivalent to BC requirements.
questions.explanationZh: EMA Regulation s.3(3)：Board 可以要求申请人先完成考试或培训，但选择考核内容时只能覆盖原管辖区考试或培训与 BC 要求不等效的部分。

questions.questionEn: What is the maximum total period of a short term licence issued to a non-student under s.4 of the EMA Regulation?
questions.questionZh: 依 EMA Regulation s.4 向非学生签发的短期 licence，总时长上限是多少？

options.textEn: 1 year
options.textZh: 1 年

options.textEn: 30 days
60 days
6 months
options.textZh: 6 个月

questions.explanationEn: Under s.4(2), the board may issue a short term licence for up to 30 days and extend it in 30-day increments on one or more occasions, but the total period must not exceed one year.
questions.explanationZh: 依 s.4(2)，Board 可签发最长 30 天的短期 licence，并可多次每次延长最多 30 天，但总时长不得超过一年。

questions.questionEn: A student licence issued under s.5 of the EMA Regulation, including all extensions, must not exceed a total of:
questions.questionZh: 依 EMA Regulation s.5 签发的学生 licence，含所有延期在内总时长不得超过：

options.textEn: 3 years
options.textZh: 3 年

options.textEn: 18 months
options.textZh: 18 个月

options.textEn: 1 year
options.textZh: 1 年

options.textEn: 2 years
options.textZh: 2 年

questions.explanationEn: Under s.5, a student licence may be issued for up to a year and extended by up to 180 days at a time, but the total period including the initial term must not exceed 2 years.
questions.explanationZh: 依 s.5，学生 licence 初次可发最长 1 年，之后每次可延长最多 180 天，但含初始期限在内总时长不得超过 2 年。

questions.questionEn: A temporary licence in extraordinary circumstances under s.6 of the EMA Regulation is issued at whose request, and for what maximum total period?
questions.questionZh: EMA Regulation s.6 下的特殊情况临时 licence 应谁的请求签发？总时长上限是多少？

options.textEn: At the EMA's own request; maximum 90 days
options.textZh: 应 EMA 本人请求；最长 90 天

options.textEn: At the request of the training provider; maximum 30 days
options.textZh: 应培训机构请求；最长 30 天

options.textEn: At the request of the corporation (BCEHS); maximum total 60 days
options.textZh: 应 corporation（BCEHS）请求；总时长最多 60 天

options.textEn: At the request of the Minister of Health; maximum 1 year
options.textZh: 应卫生厅长请求；最长 1 年

questions.explanationEn: Under s.6(2), the corporation may request the temporary licence where necessary for the protection of public health or safety. Under s.6(6), it may be issued for up to 30 days and extended, but the total period must not exceed 60 days.
questions.explanationZh: 依 s.6(2)，当保护公众健康或安全所必需时，由 corporation 向 Board 提出请求。依 s.6(6)，每次最多 30 天、可延期，但总时长不得超过 60 天。

questions.questionEn: Under s.7 of the EMA Regulation, Washington State emergency medical personnel collectively recognized by the licensing board may practise in BC only:
questions.questionZh: 依 EMA Regulation s.7，被 licensing board 集体承认的华盛顿州急救人员，只能在什么情形下在 BC 执业？

options.textEn: Only in border municipalities
options.textZh: 只能在边境城市

options.textEn: Only after passing the BC jurisprudence exam
options.textZh: 只有通过 BC jurisprudence 考试后

options.textEn: While transporting patients from the United States to medical facilities in BC or the US, within their Washington authorization
options.textZh: 在其华盛顿州授权范围内，从美国向 BC 或美国的医疗机构转运患者的过程中

options.textEn: Anywhere in BC while off duty
options.textZh: 下班时间可在 BC 任何地方执业

questions.explanationEn: s.7(2) restricts the collective licence to services the persons are authorized to provide in Washington, under the supervision and control required by their Washington certification, and provided in BC while transporting patients from the US to medical facilities in BC or the US.
questions.explanationZh: s.7(2) 将该集体 licence 限定为：华盛顿州授权范围内的服务，须遵守其华盛顿认证要求的监督和控制，且仅限从美国向 BC 或美国的医疗机构转运患者时在 BC 境内提供。

questions.questionEn: Which statement about the title 'emergency medical assistant' is correct?
questions.questionZh: 关于 'emergency medical assistant' 这一头衔，下列哪项正确？

options.textEn: The title is only protected while on duty
options.textZh: 该头衔只在当班期间受保护

options.textEn: A person must not use the title or represent themselves as an EMA unless they hold a valid and subsisting licence
options.textZh: 除非持有有效且存续的 licence，任何人不得使用该头衔或自称 EMA

options.textEn: It may be used by anyone employed by an ambulance service
options.textZh: 受雇于救护服务机构的任何人都可以使用

options.textEn: Anyone who has completed first aid training may use it
options.textZh: 完成急救培训的任何人都可以使用

questions.explanationEn: EHS Act s.12: a person must not assume or use the title 'emergency medical assistant', or a prescribed title, or otherwise represent themselves to be an EMA unless they hold a valid and subsisting licence under the Act. The corporation may seek an injunction against contraventions (s.9.1).
questions.explanationZh: EHS Act s.12：除非持有本法下有效且存续的 licence，任何人不得使用 'emergency medical assistant' 头衔或规定头衔，也不得以其他方式自称 EMA。corporation 可就违反行为申请禁制令（s.9.1）。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following is NOT a licence category under s.8(1) of the EMA Regulation?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项不是 EMA Regulation s.8(1) 规定的 licence 类别？

options.textEn: Emergency Medical Assistant First Responder (EMA FR)
options.textZh: Emergency Medical Assistant First Responder (EMA FR)

options.textEn: Emergency Medical Technician (EMT)
options.textZh: Emergency Medical Technician (EMT)

options.textEn: Infant Transport Team (ITT)
options.textZh: Infant Transport Team (ITT)

options.textEn: Critical Care Paramedic (CCP)
options.textZh: Critical Care Paramedic (CCP)

questions.explanationEn: s.8(1) lists six categories: EMA FR, EMR, PCP, ACP, CCP and ITT. 'Emergency Medical Technician' is a US designation, not a BC licence category. Also note an EMA may be licensed in only ONE category at a time.
questions.explanationZh: s.8(1) 列出六个类别：EMA FR、EMR、PCP、ACP、CCP、ITT。'Emergency Medical Technician' 是美国的称谓，不是 BC 的 licence 类别。另外注意：一名 EMA 同一时间只能持有一个类别的 licence。

questions.questionEn: What is the licence renewal fee for an EMR or PCP?
questions.questionZh: EMR 或 PCP 的 licence 续牌费是多少？

options.textEn: There is no renewal fee
options.textZh: 不收续牌费

questions.explanationEn: Per the Exam Guidelines fee table, EMR and PCP renewal is $50. Initial fees are $50 (written exam only), $400 (practical exam), or $450 (both). There is no fee for EMA FR licensing, student licensing, or initial licensing of applicants transferring from another province.
questions.explanationZh: 按考试指南的费用表，EMR 和 PCP 续牌费为 $50。首次发牌费为：只需笔试 $50、需实操 $400、两者都需 $450。EMA FR 发牌、学生牌照、从其他省份转入的首次发牌不收费。

questions.questionEn: Under s.8.1 of the EMA Regulation, by what date must every EMA provide the licensing board with evidence of exams/training for the services added to Schedule 1 by B.C. Reg. 194/2022?
questions.questionZh: 依 EMA Regulation s.8.1，每名 EMA 必须在哪个日期之前向 licensing board 提交 B.C. Reg. 194/2022 新增 Schedule 1 服务所需的考试/培训证明？

options.textEn: April 1, 2027
There is no deadline
options.textZh: 没有截止日期

options.textEn: On or before September 23, 2027
options.textZh: 2027 年 9 月 23 日或之前

options.textEn: December 31, 2026

questions.explanationEn: s.8.1(2): it is a condition of every licence that the EMA provide the evidence referred to in s.8.1(1)(a) to the licensing board on or before September 23, 2027. Until the board accepts that evidence, the EMA must not provide the services added by B.C. Reg. 194/2022.
questions.explanationZh: s.8.1(2)：每张 licence 都附带条件——EMA 须在 2027 年 9 月 23 日或之前向 licensing board 提交 s.8.1(1)(a) 所述证明。在 Board 接受该证明之前，EMA 不得提供 B.C. Reg. 194/2022 新增的服务。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following may an EMR provide as a licensed service WITHOUT any endorsement?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项服务 EMR 持牌即可提供，无需任何 endorsement？

options.textEn: Administration of nebulized bronchodilators
options.textZh: 雾化支气管扩张剂给药

options.textEn: Maintenance of intravenous lines
options.textZh: 维护静脉（IV）线路

options.textEn: Transportation
options.textZh: 转运（transportation）

options.textEn: Chest auscultation
options.textZh: 胸部听诊

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 1, s.2 lists EMR licensed services: all EMA FR Schedule 1 and Schedule 2 services, occupational first aid, transportation, and soft tissue injury treatment. Chest auscultation, IV maintenance and nebulized bronchodilators are all EMR Schedule 2 services requiring an endorsement.
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 1 s.2 列出的 EMR 持牌服务包括：EMA FR 的全部 Schedule 1 和 Schedule 2 服务、职业急救、转运、软组织损伤处理。胸部听诊、IV 维护和雾化支气管扩张剂都属于 EMR Schedule 2，需要 endorsement。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 1 s.2; Schedule 2 s.2

questions.questionEn: How does the EMR licensed scope relate to the EMA FR schedules?
questions.questionZh: EMR 的持牌范围与 EMA FR 的两个 Schedule 是什么关系？

options.textEn: An EMR needs a separate endorsement for each EMA FR Schedule 2 service
options.textZh: EMR 要为每项 EMA FR Schedule 2 服务单独取得 endorsement

options.textEn: An EMR may provide only EMA FR Schedule 1 services
options.textZh: EMR 只能提供 EMA FR 的 Schedule 1 服务

options.textEn: An EMR may provide all EMA FR Schedule 1 AND Schedule 2 services as part of their licensed scope
options.textZh: EMR 持牌范围包含 EMA FR 的全部 Schedule 1 和 Schedule 2 服务

options.textEn: EMR scope is unrelated to the EMA FR schedules
options.textZh: EMR 的范围与 EMA FR 的 Schedule 无关

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 1, s.2(a): an EMR may provide 'all services specified in this Schedule and Schedule 2 for the category of EMA FR'. Scopes are cumulative — each category absorbs both schedules of the level below. So, for example, IM/intranasal naloxone (FR Schedule 2, s.1(m)) is base scope for an EMR.
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 1 s.2(a)：EMR 可提供 'EMA FR 类别在本 Schedule 和 Schedule 2 中的全部服务'。执业范围是累加的——每个类别吸收下一级的两个 Schedule。例如 IM/鼻内 naloxone（FR Schedule 2 s.1(m)）对 EMR 来说就是基础范围。

questions.questionEn: May an EMR use an automated external defibrillator (AED) without an endorsement?
questions.questionZh: EMR 无需 endorsement 就可以使用自动体外除颤器（AED）吗？

options.textEn: No — AED use requires an EMR endorsement
options.textZh: 不行——使用 AED 需要 EMR endorsement

options.textEn: Yes — automatic and semi-automatic defibrillators are an EMA FR Schedule 1 service, inherited by the EMR
options.textZh: 可以——自动和半自动除颤器属于 EMA FR 的 Schedule 1 服务，EMR 全部继承

options.textEn: No — defibrillation of any kind requires a PCP licence
options.textZh: 不行——任何形式的除颤都需要 PCP licence

options.textEn: Yes, but only with online medical oversight
options.textZh: 可以，但必须有在线医疗指导

questions.explanationEn: Use of automatic and semi-automatic defibrillators is listed in Schedule 1, s.1(i) for the EMA FR category, and EMR Schedule 1 includes all FR Schedule 1 services. Note the contrast: MANUAL defibrillation with cardiac rhythm interpretation is a PCP Schedule 2 (endorsement) service.
questions.explanationZh: 自动和半自动除颤器的使用列在 EMA FR 的 Schedule 1 s.1(i)，而 EMR 的 Schedule 1 包含 FR 的全部 Schedule 1 服务。注意对比：手动除颤加心律解读是 PCP 的 Schedule 2（endorsement）服务。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 1 s.1(i), s.2(a); Schedule 2 s.3(j)

questions.questionEn: With the appropriate endorsement, what is an EMR permitted to do with intravenous lines?
questions.questionZh: 取得相应 endorsement 后，EMR 对静脉（IV）线路可以做什么？

options.textEn: Initiate peripheral IV lines
options.textZh: 建立外周 IV 通路

options.textEn: Maintain IV lines without medications or blood products
options.textZh: 维护不含药物或血制品的 IV 线路

options.textEn: Maintain IV lines including medication infusions
options.textZh: 维护含药物输注的 IV 线路

options.textEn: Initiate intraosseous cannulation
options.textZh: 进行骨内（IO）穿刺

questions.explanationEn: EMR Schedule 2, s.2(a) permits (with endorsement) 'maintenance of intravenous lines without medications or blood products'. Initiation of peripheral IV lines is a PCP Schedule 1 service (s.3(e)); IV lines with medications are ACP scope; IO cannulation is a PCP endorsement.
questions.explanationZh: EMR Schedule 2 s.2(a) 允许（需 endorsement）'维护不含药物或血制品的 IV 线路'。建立外周 IV 是 PCP 的 Schedule 1 服务（s.3(e)）；含药 IV 维护属 ACP；IO 穿刺是 PCP 的 endorsement。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 2 s.2(a); Schedule 1 s.3(e)

questions.questionEn: A patient has overdosed on opioids. May an EMR administer intramuscular or intranasal naloxone (an opioid antagonist) without an endorsement?
questions.questionZh: 患者阿片类药物过量。EMR 无需 endorsement 就可以给予肌注或鼻内 naloxone（opioid antagonist）吗？

options.textEn: No — naloxone by any route is PCP-only
options.textZh: 不行——任何途径的 naloxone 都只有 PCP 能给

options.textEn: No — an EMR must first obtain a Schedule 2 endorsement
options.textZh: 不行——EMR 必须先取得 Schedule 2 endorsement

options.textEn: Yes, but only if a physician authorizes it by phone
options.textZh: 可以，但必须有医生电话授权

options.textEn: Yes — IM and intranasal opioid antagonists are EMA FR Schedule 2 services, which fall within the EMR's licensed scope
options.textZh: 可以——IM 和鼻内 opioid antagonist 属 EMA FR Schedule 2 服务，已包含在 EMR 的持牌范围内

questions.explanationEn: Intramuscular and intranasal administration of opioid antagonists is EMA FR Schedule 2, s.1(m). Because EMR Schedule 1, s.2(a) incorporates all FR Schedule 1 AND Schedule 2 services, an EMR may provide it as a licensed service without an endorsement. PCPs may additionally give opioid antagonists by other routes (including IV) under Schedule 1, s.3(b)(i).
questions.explanationZh: IM 和鼻内 opioid antagonist 给药列于 EMA FR Schedule 2 s.1(m)。由于 EMR Schedule 1 s.2(a) 纳入了 FR 的全部 Schedule 1 和 Schedule 2 服务，EMR 持牌即可提供，无需 endorsement。PCP 依 Schedule 1 s.3(b)(i) 还可经其他途径（包括 IV）给予 opioid antagonist。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 2 s.1(m); Schedule 1 s.2(a), s.3(b)(i)

questions.questionEn: Which form of epinephrine administration requires an EMR-level Schedule 2 endorsement (rather than being in the EMR's base scope)?
questions.questionZh: 哪种肾上腺素给药方式需要 EMR 级 Schedule 2 endorsement（而不属于 EMR 基础范围）？

options.textEn: Epinephrine by intramuscular auto-injector
options.textZh: 肾上腺素 IM 自动注射器（auto-injector）

options.textEn: Intranasal epinephrine preparations
options.textZh: 鼻内肾上腺素制剂

options.textEn: Sublingual epinephrine preparations
options.textZh: 舌下肾上腺素制剂

options.textEn: Intramuscular administration of epinephrine (drawn up)
options.textZh: 肌注肾上腺素（自行抽药）

questions.explanationEn: EMA FR Schedule 2, s.1(k) covers epinephrine by IM auto-injector or intranasal/sublingual preparations — inherited by the EMR as base scope. 'Intramuscular administration of epinephrine' (i.e. drawn up from an ampoule) is a separate EMR Schedule 2 endorsement (s.2(g)).
questions.explanationZh: EMA FR Schedule 2 s.1(k) 覆盖 IM 自动注射器和鼻内/舌下肾上腺素制剂——EMR 作为基础范围继承。而'肌注肾上腺素'（即自行从安瓿抽药注射）是单独的 EMR Schedule 2 endorsement（s.2(g)）。

questions.questionEn: An endorsed EMR may administer which of the following oral, sublingual or inhaled medication classes under Schedule 2, s.2(c)?
questions.questionZh: 依 Schedule 2 s.2(c)，取得 endorsement 的 EMR 可经口服、舌下或吸入途径给予下列哪类药物？

options.textEn: Opioid analgesics
options.textZh: 阿片类镇痛药

options.textEn: Corticosteroids
options.textZh: 糖皮质激素（corticosteroids）

options.textEn: Anti-anginals, analgesics and platelet inhibitors
options.textZh: 抗心绞痛药、镇痛药和抗血小板药

options.textEn: Sedatives
options.textZh: 镇静剂

questions.explanationEn: EMR Schedule 2, s.2(c) lists oral, sublingual or inhaled anti-anginals (e.g. nitroglycerin), analgesics and platelet inhibitors (e.g. ASA). Corticosteroids and opioid analgesics are PCP Schedule 2 endorsements; sedatives are ACP scope.
questions.explanationZh: EMR Schedule 2 s.2(c) 列出口服、舌下或吸入的抗心绞痛药（如硝酸甘油）、镇痛药和抗血小板药（如 ASA）。糖皮质激素和阿片类镇痛药是 PCP 的 Schedule 2 endorsement；镇静剂属 ACP 范围。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 2 s.2(c); Schedule 2 s.3(f); Schedule 1 s.4(m)

questions.questionEn: Chest auscultation may be performed by an EMR:
questions.questionZh: EMR 在什么条件下可以进行胸部听诊（chest auscultation）？

options.textEn: Only under direct physician supervision
options.textZh: 只有在医生直接监督下才可以

options.textEn: As part of the base EMR licensed scope
options.textZh: 属 EMR 基础持牌范围，直接可做

options.textEn: Only with a Schedule 2 endorsement
options.textZh: 只有取得 Schedule 2 endorsement 才可以

options.textEn: Never — it is restricted to PCP and above
options.textZh: 不行——仅限 PCP 及以上

questions.explanationEn: Chest auscultation is listed in EMR Schedule 2, s.2(e) — it is an endorsement service at the EMR level, granted under s.10 after board-approved exams and/or training.
questions.explanationZh: 胸部听诊列于 EMR Schedule 2 s.2(e)——在 EMR 级别属 endorsement 服务，须依 s.10 通过 Board 批准的考试和/或培训后授予。

questions.questionEn: A patient with asthma needs salbutamol by nebulizer. For an EMR, administration of bronchodilators by inhalation and nebulization is:
questions.questionZh: 哮喘患者需要雾化 salbutamol。对 EMR 来说，经吸入和雾化给予支气管扩张剂属于：

options.textEn: A Schedule 2 endorsement service
options.textZh: Schedule 2 endorsement 服务

options.textEn: Prohibited at the EMR level entirely
options.textZh: EMR 级别完全禁止

options.textEn: Permitted only during interfacility transfers
options.textZh: 仅限机构间转运时

options.textEn: A base licensed service
options.textZh: 基础持牌服务

questions.explanationEn: Administration of bronchodilators by inhalation and nebulization is EMR Schedule 2, s.2(h) — an endorsement service. At the PCP level, sympathomimetic agents by nebulized and other routes fall under Schedule 1, s.3(b).
questions.explanationZh: 经吸入和雾化给予支气管扩张剂是 EMR Schedule 2 s.2(h)——endorsement 服务。到 PCP 级别，经雾化等途径给予拟交感药属于 Schedule 1 s.3(b) 的基础范围。

questions.questionEn: Which service first appears as a LICENSED (Schedule 1) service at the EMR category?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项服务是从 EMR 类别开始才成为持牌（Schedule 1）服务的？

options.textEn: Oxygen administration
options.textZh: 给氧

options.textEn: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation
options.textZh: 心肺复苏（CPR）

options.textEn: Occupational first aid
options.textZh: 职业急救（occupational first aid）

options.textEn: Scene assessment
options.textZh: 现场评估

questions.explanationEn: Occupational first aid appears in Schedule 1, s.2(b) for the EMR category. CPR, oxygen administration and scene assessment are already EMA FR Schedule 1 services (s.1).
questions.explanationZh: 职业急救列于 EMR 类别的 Schedule 1 s.2(b)。CPR、给氧和现场评估在 EMA FR 的 Schedule 1（s.1）里就已经是持牌服务。

questions.questionEn: Which airway interventions are within the base scope of both EMA FR and EMR?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪些气道处置属于 EMA FR 和 EMR 共同的基础范围？

options.textEn: Oropharyngeal/nasopharyngeal airways, suction and bag-valve-mask devices
options.textZh: 口咽/鼻咽通气道（OPA/NPA）、吸引及 BVM

options.textEn: Supraglottic airway devices
options.textZh: 声门上气道装置

options.textEn: Cricothyrotomy
options.textZh: 环甲膜切开

options.textEn: Endotracheal intubation
options.textZh: 气管插管

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 1, s.1(g): EMA FR base scope includes maintenance of airways and ventilation by OPA/NPA insertion and maintenance, suction devices and bag-valve-mask devices. Airway devices not requiring laryngeal visualization (supraglottic) are PCP Schedule 1; endotracheal intubation is a PCP endorsement; cricothyrotomy is ACP.
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 1 s.1(g)：EMA FR 基础范围包括通过 OPA/NPA 置入与维护、吸引装置和 BVM 维持气道与通气。无需喉部可视化的气道装置（声门上气道）是 PCP Schedule 1；气管插管是 PCP endorsement；环甲膜切开属 ACP。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 1 s.1(g), s.3(c); Schedule 2 s.3(c); Schedule 1 s.4(g)

questions.questionEn: At the EMA FR/EMR base level, wound management is limited to wounds that:
questions.questionZh: 在 EMA FR/EMR 基础级别，伤口处理仅限于什么样的伤口处理？

options.textEn: Require suturing
options.textZh: 需要缝合的

options.textEn: Do not require tissue puncture or indentation
options.textZh: 不需要组织穿刺或压入的

options.textEn: Involve only the extremities
options.textZh: 只涉及四肢的

options.textEn: Are less than 24 hours old
options.textZh: 受伤不超过 24 小时的

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 1, s.1(j) permits 'wound management not requiring tissue puncture or indentation' at the EMA FR level (inherited by EMR). Invasive wound management appears only as an ACP Schedule 2 endorsement (s.4(n)).
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 1 s.1(j) 允许 EMA FR（EMR 继承）进行'不需要组织穿刺或压入的伤口处理'。侵入性伤口处理（invasive wound management）只出现在 ACP 的 Schedule 2 endorsement（s.4(n)）中。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 1 s.1(j); Schedule 2 s.4(n)

questions.questionEn: During a declared public health emergency, an emergency order made by the provincial health officer under Part 6 of the EMA Regulation may:
questions.questionZh: 在宣布的公共卫生紧急状态期间，省卫生官依 EMA Regulation Part 6 发布的 emergency order 可以：

options.textEn: Authorize, but not require, an EMA to perform specified activities or services beyond their normal scope
options.textZh: 授权——但不强制——EMA 提供超出其常规范围的特定活动或服务

options.textEn: Require every EMA to perform expanded services
options.textZh: 强制要求所有 EMA 提供扩展服务

options.textEn: Permanently amend Schedule 1
options.textZh: 永久修改 Schedule 1

options.textEn: Override limits the licensing board has placed on an individual EMA's licence
options.textZh: 推翻 licensing board 对个别 EMA licence 施加的限制

questions.explanationEn: s.32 empowers the provincial health officer to 'authorize, but not require' an EMA to perform specified activities or services otherwise outside the regulation, or under modified/waived standards. s.37(1) confirms an emergency order cannot authorize acting contrary to board-imposed limits or conditions, and the order is time-limited (s.30), not a permanent amendment.
questions.explanationZh: s.32 授权省卫生官 '授权但不强制'（authorize, but not require）EMA 提供本法规原本不允许的特定活动或服务，或在修改/豁免标准下操作。s.37(1) 明确 emergency order 不能授权违反 Board 施加的限制或条件，且命令有时限（s.30），并非永久修法。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following may a PCP perform as a licensed (Schedule 1) service WITHOUT an endorsement?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项是 PCP 持牌（Schedule 1）即可提供、无需 endorsement 的服务？

options.textEn: Endotracheal intubation
options.textZh: 气管插管

options.textEn: Administration of isotonic crystalloid solutions
options.textZh: 输注等渗晶体液

options.textEn: Initiation of peripheral intravenous lines
options.textZh: 建立外周静脉（IV）通路

options.textEn: Manual defibrillation with cardiac rhythm interpretation
options.textZh: 手动除颤加心律解读

questions.explanationEn: Initiation of peripheral IV lines is PCP Schedule 1, s.3(e). Endotracheal intubation (Sch 2 s.3(c)), manual defibrillation with rhythm interpretation (s.3(j)) and isotonic crystalloids (s.3(b)) are all PCP Schedule 2 endorsement services.
questions.explanationZh: 建立外周 IV 是 PCP Schedule 1 s.3(e)。气管插管（Sch 2 s.3(c)）、手动除颤加心律解读（s.3(j)）、等渗晶体液（s.3(b)）都是 PCP 的 Schedule 2 endorsement 服务。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 1 s.3(e); Schedule 2 s.3(b), (c), (j)

questions.questionEn: Which analgesic class falls within the PCP's base Schedule 1 medication list?
questions.questionZh: 哪类镇痛药属于 PCP 基础 Schedule 1 药物清单？

options.textEn: Anti-convulsants
options.textZh: 抗惊厥药

options.textEn: Sedatives
options.textZh: 镇静剂

options.textEn: Non-opioid analgesics
options.textZh: 非阿片类镇痛药

options.textEn: Opioid analgesics
options.textZh: 阿片类镇痛药

questions.explanationEn: PCP Schedule 1, s.3(b)(viii) includes non-opioid analgesics. Opioid analgesics require a PCP Schedule 2 endorsement (s.3(f)(iv)); sedatives and anti-convulsants are ACP Schedule 1 medications (s.4(m)).
questions.explanationZh: PCP Schedule 1 s.3(b)(viii) 包含非阿片类镇痛药。阿片类镇痛药需要 PCP Schedule 2 endorsement（s.3(f)(iv)）；镇静剂和抗惊厥药是 ACP 的 Schedule 1 药物（s.4(m)）。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 1 s.3(b)(viii); Schedule 2 s.3(f)(iv); Schedule 1 s.4(m)

questions.questionEn: Regarding airway management, which is TRUE for a PCP without any endorsement?
questions.questionZh: 关于气道管理，对没有任何 endorsement 的 PCP 来说，下列哪项正确？

options.textEn: They may perform cricothyrotomy
options.textZh: 可以进行环甲膜切开

options.textEn: They may perform endotracheal intubation
options.textZh: 可以进行气管插管

options.textEn: They may insert airway devices not requiring visualization of the larynx (supraglottic airways)
options.textZh: 可以置入无需喉部可视化的气道装置（声门上气道）

options.textEn: They are limited to oropharyngeal airways only
options.textZh: 只能使用口咽通气道（OPA）

questions.explanationEn: PCP Schedule 1, s.3(c): 'insertion and maintenance of airway devices not requiring visualization of the larynx'. Endotracheal intubation requires a PCP Schedule 2 endorsement (s.3(c) of Schedule 2), and cricothyrotomy is ACP Schedule 1 (s.4(g)). OPA/NPA are inherited from FR scope, but the PCP is not limited to them.
questions.explanationZh: PCP Schedule 1 s.3(c)：'置入和维护无需喉部可视化的气道装置'。气管插管需要 PCP 的 Schedule 2 endorsement（Schedule 2 s.3(c)），环甲膜切开属 ACP Schedule 1（s.4(g)）。OPA/NPA 从 FR 范围继承，但 PCP 并不仅限于此。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 1 s.3(c); Schedule 2 s.3(c); Schedule 1 s.4(g)

questions.questionEn: For a PCP, manual defibrillation with cardiac rhythm interpretation is:
questions.questionZh: 对 PCP 来说，手动除颤加心律解读属于：

options.textEn: A Schedule 2 endorsement service
options.textZh: Schedule 2 endorsement 服务

options.textEn: An ACP-only service
options.textZh: 仅 ACP 可做的服务

options.textEn: A base Schedule 1 service
options.textZh: 基础 Schedule 1 服务

options.textEn: Prohibited in the prehospital setting
options.textZh: 院前环境中被禁止

questions.explanationEn: Manual defibrillation with cardiac rhythm interpretation is PCP Schedule 2, s.3(j) — endorsement required. The base defibrillation capability for all EMAs from FR up is automatic/semi-automatic defibrillators (Schedule 1, s.1(i)).
questions.explanationZh: 手动除颤加心律解读是 PCP Schedule 2 s.3(j)——需要 endorsement。从 FR 起所有 EMA 的基础除颤能力是自动/半自动除颤器（Schedule 1 s.1(i)）。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 2 s.3(j); Schedule 1 s.1(i)

questions.questionEn: End-tidal carbon dioxide (EtCO2) monitoring is, for a PCP:
questions.questionZh: 呼气末二氧化碳（EtCO2）监测对 PCP 来说属于：

options.textEn: Restricted to ACP and above
options.textZh: 仅限 ACP 及以上

options.textEn: A base Schedule 1 licensed service
options.textZh: 基础 Schedule 1 持牌服务

options.textEn: A Schedule 2 endorsement service
options.textZh: Schedule 2 endorsement 服务

options.textEn: Permitted only during cardiac arrest
options.textZh: 仅限心脏骤停时使用

questions.explanationEn: End-tidal carbon dioxide monitoring is listed in PCP Schedule 1, s.3(g) — no endorsement required.
questions.explanationZh: 呼气末二氧化碳监测列于 PCP Schedule 1 s.3(g)——无需 endorsement。

questions.questionEn: Under PCP Schedule 1, point-of-care testing may be performed for what purpose?
questions.questionZh: 依 PCP Schedule 1，即时检验（point-of-care testing）可用于什么目的？

options.textEn: Routine annual health screening
options.textZh: 常规年度健康筛查

options.textEn: Insurance documentation
options.textZh: 保险文书用途

options.textEn: Research data collection only
options.textZh: 仅用于研究数据收集

options.textEn: To inform emergency treatment or transportation decisions, or to provide information for subsequent treatment
options.textZh: 为紧急治疗或转运决策提供依据，或为后续治疗提供信息

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 1, s.3(f): point-of-care testing 'to inform emergency treatment or transportation decisions or to provide information for subsequent treatment'.
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 1 s.3(f)：即时检验的目的是'为紧急治疗或转运决策提供依据，或为后续治疗提供信息'。

questions.questionEn: A PCP wants to administer a bolus of normal saline (an isotonic crystalloid). This requires:
questions.questionZh: PCP 想输注生理盐水（等渗晶体液）快速补液，这需要：

options.textEn: An ACP licence
options.textZh: ACP licence

options.textEn: Nothing further — it is base PCP scope
options.textZh: 无需额外条件——属 PCP 基础范围

options.textEn: A physician physically present
options.textZh: 医生亲自在场

options.textEn: A Schedule 2 endorsement on the PCP's licence
options.textZh: PCP 的 licence 上有相应的 Schedule 2 endorsement

questions.explanationEn: Administration of isotonic crystalloid solutions is PCP Schedule 2, s.3(b) — an endorsement service. Base PCP Schedule 1 covers initiating and maintaining IV lines (s.3(d), (e)) but the crystalloid administration itself is endorsed.
questions.explanationZh: 输注等渗晶体液是 PCP Schedule 2 s.3(b)——endorsement 服务。PCP 基础 Schedule 1 覆盖建立和维护 IV 线路（s.3(d)、(e)），但晶体液输注本身需要 endorsement。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 2 s.3(b); Schedule 1 s.3(d), (e)

questions.questionEn: Initiation and maintenance of non-invasive positive pressure airway devices (e.g. CPAP) is available to a PCP:
questions.questionZh: 无创正压气道装置（如 CPAP）的启动与维护，PCP 在什么条件下可以做？

options.textEn: With a Schedule 2 endorsement
options.textZh: 取得 Schedule 2 endorsement 后

options.textEn: Only at the CCP level
options.textZh: 仅限 CCP 级别

options.textEn: Never in the prehospital environment
options.textZh: 院前环境中永远不可以

options.textEn: As base Schedule 1 scope
options.textZh: 属基础 Schedule 1 范围

questions.explanationEn: Initiation and maintenance of non-invasive positive pressure airway devices is PCP Schedule 2, s.3(e) — an endorsement service granted under s.10.
questions.explanationZh: 无创正压气道装置的启动与维护是 PCP Schedule 2 s.3(e)——依 s.10 授予的 endorsement 服务。

questions.questionEn: An endorsed PCP administering drug therapy during an interfacility transfer must do so:
questions.questionZh: 取得 endorsement 的 PCP 在机构间转运中给予药物治疗时，必须满足什么条件？

options.textEn: In accordance with a treatment plan issued by the patient's attending medical practitioner at the sending facility, AND after consultation with a designated medical oversight advisor
options.textZh: 须依转出机构主治医生开具的 treatment plan，并且经与指定的 medical oversight advisor 磋商后

options.textEn: Only for cardiac medications
options.textZh: 仅限心脏用药

options.textEn: Only if a nurse escorts the patient
options.textZh: 只有护士随行时

options.textEn: According to their own clinical judgment alone
options.textZh: 仅凭自己的临床判断即可

questions.explanationEn: PCP Schedule 2, s.3(n) sets two cumulative conditions: (i) in accordance with a treatment plan issued by the patient's attending medical practitioner at the facility from which the patient is being transported, and (ii) after consultation with a medical practitioner designated by an employer as a medical oversight advisor who has advised administering the therapy.
questions.explanationZh: PCP Schedule 2 s.3(n) 设置了两个必须同时满足的条件：(i) 依转出机构患者主治医生开具的 treatment plan 执行；(ii) 经与雇主指定的 medical oversight advisor（医疗指导顾问）磋商且获其建议后给药。

questions.questionEn: Initiation and maintenance of intraosseous (IO) needle cannulation with local anesthetic instillation is, for a PCP:
questions.questionZh: 骨内（IO）穿刺置管（含局麻药灌注）的启动与维护，对 PCP 来说属于：

options.textEn: Prohibited for all EMAs
options.textZh: 所有 EMA 都禁止

options.textEn: Available only to CCP
options.textZh: 仅 CCP 可做

options.textEn: A base Schedule 1 service
options.textZh: 基础 Schedule 1 服务

options.textEn: A Schedule 2 endorsement service
options.textZh: Schedule 2 endorsement 服务

questions.explanationEn: PCP Schedule 2, s.3(h): initiation and maintenance of intraosseous needle cannulation with local anesthetic instillation requires an endorsement on the PCP licence.
questions.explanationZh: PCP Schedule 2 s.3(h)：骨内穿刺置管（含局麻药灌注）的启动与维护需要 PCP licence 上有 endorsement。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following remains OUTSIDE a PCP's scope even with every available PCP endorsement?
questions.questionZh: 即使拿到 PCP 所有可用的 endorsement，下列哪项仍然超出 PCP 的执业范围？

options.textEn: Needle thoracentesis
options.textZh: 穿刺减压（needle thoracentesis）

options.textEn: Electrocardiogram interpretation
options.textZh: 心电图解读

options.textEn: Endotracheal intubation
options.textZh: 气管插管

options.textEn: Cricothyrotomy
options.textZh: 环甲膜切开

questions.explanationEn: Cricothyrotomy appears only at ACP Schedule 1 (s.4(g)) — no PCP endorsement covers it. Needle thoracentesis (Sch 2 s.3(l)), ECG interpretation (s.3(k)) and endotracheal intubation (s.3(c)) are all available to a PCP with the appropriate endorsement.
questions.explanationZh: 环甲膜切开只出现在 ACP 的 Schedule 1（s.4(g)）——没有任何 PCP endorsement 覆盖它。穿刺减压（Sch 2 s.3(l)）、心电图解读（s.3(k)）和气管插管（s.3(c)）在取得相应 endorsement 后 PCP 都可以做。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 1 s.4(g); Schedule 2 s.3(c), (k), (l)

questions.questionEn: How does an EMA obtain an endorsement to provide a Schedule 2 service?
questions.questionZh: EMA 如何取得提供 Schedule 2 服务的 endorsement？

options.textEn: Automatically after 2 years of practice
options.textZh: 执业满 2 年后自动获得

options.textEn: By applying to BCEHS medical programs
options.textZh: 向 BCEHS 医疗项目部申请

options.textEn: By self-declaring competence to their employer
options.textZh: 向雇主自行声明具备能力

options.textEn: By providing evidence of passing board-approved examinations and/or completing board-recognized training, as the board determines necessary, after which the board may endorse the licence
options.textZh: 按 Board 的要求提供通过 Board 批准考试和/或完成 Board 认可培训的证明，之后由 Board 在 licence 上加注 endorsement

questions.explanationEn: s.10(1): if an EMA provides satisfactory evidence of passing the approved examinations, completing recognized training, or both (as the board determines necessary), the licensing board may endorse the licence to permit the Schedule 2 service for their category. The board may also endorse licences for approved research projects (s.10(2)).
questions.explanationZh: s.10(1)：EMA 按 Board 的要求提供令其满意的证明——通过批准的考试、完成认可的培训、或两者兼备——之后 licensing board 可在 licence 上加注 endorsement，允许其提供本类别的 Schedule 2 服务。Board 也可为批准的研究项目加注 endorsement（s.10(2)）。

questions.questionEn: Under PCP Schedule 1, by which routes may a PCP administer an opioid antagonist such as naloxone?
questions.questionZh: 依 PCP Schedule 1，PCP 可以经哪些途径给予 naloxone 等 opioid antagonist？

options.textEn: Intravenous only
options.textZh: 仅限静脉

options.textEn: Intramuscular and intranasal only
options.textZh: 仅限肌注和鼻内

options.textEn: Inhaled, intramuscular, intranasal, intraosseous, intravenous, nebulized, oral, subcutaneous or sublingual
options.textZh: 吸入、肌注、鼻内、骨内、静脉、雾化、口服、皮下或舌下

options.textEn: Any route, but only with an endorsement
options.textZh: 任何途径，但都需要 endorsement

questions.explanationEn: PCP Schedule 1, s.3(b) authorizes administration of the listed medication classes — including opioid antagonists — by inhaled, intramuscular, intranasal, intraosseous, intravenous, nebulized, oral, subcutaneous or sublingual routes, with no endorsement needed. This contrasts with the EMR, whose inherited base is limited to IM/intranasal (FR Schedule 2, s.1(m)).
questions.explanationZh: PCP Schedule 1 s.3(b) 授权经吸入、肌注、鼻内、骨内、静脉、雾化、口服、皮下或舌下途径给予所列药物类别（含 opioid antagonist），无需 endorsement。对比 EMR：其继承的基础范围仅限 IM/鼻内（FR Schedule 2 s.1(m)）。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation Schedule 1 s.3(b)(i); Schedule 2 s.1(m)

questions.questionEn: Where is the Code of Ethics for BC EMAs found, and what is its legal force?
questions.questionZh: BC 省 EMA 的 Code of Ethics（职业道德准则）载于何处？其法律效力如何？

options.textEn: In the COPR examination handbook; it applies only during exams
options.textZh: 载于 COPR 考试手册；仅在考试期间适用

options.textEn: In Schedule 3 of the EMA Regulation; compliance is a condition of every licence
options.textZh: 载于 EMA Regulation 的 Schedule 3；遵守它是每张 licence 的附带条件

options.textEn: In the Health Professions and Occupations Act
options.textZh: 载于 Health Professions and Occupations Act

options.textEn: In a BCEHS policy manual; it is advisory only
options.textZh: 载于 BCEHS 政策手册；仅供参考

questions.explanationEn: The Code of Ethics is Schedule 3 of the EMA Regulation. Under s.11, it is a condition of every licence that the EMA comply with the Act and the regulations, including without limitation the Code of Ethics set out in Schedule 3 — so a breach can ground discipline as a breach of licence condition.
questions.explanationZh: Code of Ethics 是 EMA Regulation 的 Schedule 3。依 s.11，每张 licence 都附带条件：EMA 必须遵守 Act 和法规，特别包括 Schedule 3 的 Code of Ethics——因此违反它可作为违反 licence 条件而构成纪律处分事由。

questions.questionEn: According to the Code of Ethics, what must an EMA consider 'above all' in the exercise of their duties?
questions.questionZh: 根据 Code of Ethics，EMA 履行职责时必须把什么置于'一切之上'（above all）？

options.textEn: The instructions of their employer
options.textZh: 雇主的指示

options.textEn: The well-being of the patient
options.textZh: 患者的福祉（well-being）

options.textEn: The efficiency of the ambulance service
options.textZh: 救护服务的效率

options.textEn: Their own personal safety
options.textZh: 自身的人身安全

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 3(a): EMAs must 'consider, above all, the well-being of the patient in the exercise of their duties and responsibilities'.
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 3(a)：EMA 必须'在履行职责和责任时，把患者的福祉置于一切之上'。

questions.questionEn: An EMA witnesses a colleague providing patient care while apparently impaired. Under the Code of Ethics, the EMA must:
questions.questionZh: 某 EMA 目睹同事疑似在受损状态（impaired）下提供患者照护。依 Code of Ethics，该 EMA 必须：

options.textEn: Report the incompetent, illegal or unethical conduct to the appropriate authorities
options.textZh: 向有关当局举报该不胜任、非法或不道德行为

options.textEn: Post about it on social media as a warning
options.textZh: 在社交媒体发帖以示警告

options.textEn: Say nothing to protect the colleague's reputation
options.textZh: 为保护同事声誉而保持沉默

options.textEn: Handle it privately with the colleague only
options.textZh: 只与同事私下解决

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 3(f): EMAs must report to the appropriate authorities any incompetent, illegal or unethical conduct by colleagues or other health care personnel. Staying silent breaches the Code; public social media posts would engage other Code duties (e.g. 3(k)).
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 3(f)：EMA 必须向有关当局举报同事或其他医护人员的任何不胜任、非法或不道德行为。沉默即违反准则；发社交媒体则会触犯准则的其他条款（如 3(k)）。

questions.questionEn: An EMA repeatedly makes disparaging public comments about a coworker's clinical skills. Which Code of Ethics duty does this most directly breach?
questions.questionZh: 某 EMA 屡次公开贬低同事的临床技能。这最直接违反了 Code of Ethics 的哪项义务？

options.textEn: The duty to pursue continuing education
options.textZh: 参加继续教育的义务

options.textEn: The duty to refrain from impugning the professional reputation of a colleague or any other health care provider
options.textZh: 不得诋毁同事或其他医疗服务提供者专业声誉的义务

options.textEn: The duty to maintain patient confidentiality
options.textZh: 为患者信息保密的义务

options.textEn: The duty to obtain informed consent
options.textZh: 取得知情同意的义务

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 3(k): EMAs must refrain from impugning the professional reputation of a colleague or any other health care provider. Note this coexists with the duty to report genuine misconduct through proper channels (3(f)) — the Code prohibits disparagement, not legitimate reporting.
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 3(k)：EMA 不得诋毁同事或任何其他医疗服务提供者的专业声誉。注意它与通过正当渠道举报真实不当行为的义务（3(f)）并存——准则禁止的是诋毁，不是正当举报。

questions.questionEn: The Code of Ethics requires an EMA to protect and maintain the patient's safety and dignity regardless of which factors?
questions.questionZh: Code of Ethics 要求 EMA 在不考虑哪些因素的情况下，一律保护并维护患者的安全与尊严？

options.textEn: Only factors listed in the Canadian Charter
options.textZh: 只有加拿大宪章列出的因素

options.textEn: Only race and religion
options.textZh: 只有种族和宗教

options.textEn: The patient's ability to pay
options.textZh: 患者的支付能力

options.textEn: Race, colour, ancestry, place of origin, religion, marital status, family status, physical or mental disability, sex or sexual orientation
options.textZh: 种族、肤色、血统、原籍、宗教、婚姻状况、家庭状况、身体或精神残疾、性别或性取向

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 3(c) enumerates the protected grounds: race, colour, ancestry, place of origin, religion, marital status, family status, physical or mental disability, sex or sexual orientation.
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 3(c) 列举的保护事由为：种族、肤色、血统、原籍、宗教、婚姻状况、家庭状况、身体或精神残疾、性别或性取向。

questions.questionEn: An off-duty bystander with first aid training helps a collapsed stranger for no payment. Are they violating the Emergency Health Services Act's restrictions on providing emergency health services?
questions.questionZh: 一名下班状态、受过急救培训的路人无偿救助倒地的陌生人。这是否违反 Emergency Health Services Act 对提供紧急健康服务的限制？

options.textEn: Yes, unless they hold an EMA FR licence
options.textZh: 违反，除非其持有 EMA FR licence

options.textEn: No, but only if they call 911 first
options.textZh: 不违反，但必须先拨打 911

options.textEn: No — Good Samaritan aid is exempt where the person is not employed for that purpose and does not act with a view to gain
options.textZh: 不违反——Good Samaritan 救助属豁免情形，前提是其并非受雇专职于此、也不以营利为目的

options.textEn: Yes — only BCEHS may ever provide emergency health services
options.textZh: 违反——只有 BCEHS 才能提供紧急健康服务

questions.explanationEn: EHS Act s.5.1(4)(a): the s.5.1(3) restriction does not apply to a person rendering emergency medical services or aid as described in the Good Samaritan Act, unless the person is employed expressly for that purpose or acts with a view to gain. Occupational first aid under the Workers Compensation Act is similarly exempt (s.5.1(4)(b)).
questions.explanationZh: EHS Act s.5.1(4)(a)：s.5.1(3) 的限制不适用于依 Good Samaritan Act 提供紧急医疗服务或救助的人，除非其受雇专职于此或以营利为目的。依 Workers Compensation Act 提供的职业急救同样豁免（s.5.1(4)(b)）。

questions.questionEn: Members of the licensing board are protected from legal proceedings for damages for acts done in performing their duties, EXCEPT when the act was done:
questions.questionZh: licensing board 成员就履职行为免于损害赔偿诉讼，但下列哪种情形除外？

options.textEn: Without written authorization from the minister
options.textZh: 未经厅长书面授权

options.textEn: Outside normal business hours
options.textZh: 在正常工作时间之外

options.textEn: In bad faith
options.textZh: 恶意（bad faith）行事

options.textEn: In good faith but mistakenly
options.textZh: 善意但出错

questions.explanationEn: EHS Act s.10(2)-(3): no proceeding for damages lies against a protected individual (board of directors member, licensing board member, or corporation officer/employee) for anything done or omitted in the performance of duties — but the protection does not apply to anything done or omitted in bad faith.
questions.explanationZh: EHS Act s.10(2)-(3)：受保护人员（board of directors 成员、licensing board 成员、corporation 高管/雇员）就履职中的作为或不作为免于损害赔偿诉讼——但恶意（bad faith）作为或不作为不受保护。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following is NOT a ground for disciplinary action under s.7(1) of the Emergency Health Services Act?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项不是 Emergency Health Services Act s.7(1) 规定的纪律处分事由？

options.textEn: A physical ailment that does NOT materially impair the ability to act as an EMA
options.textZh: 并未实质损害其 EMA 执业能力的身体疾病

options.textEn: Breaching a term or condition of the licence
options.textZh: 违反 licence 的条款或条件

options.textEn: An addiction to alcohol or drugs that materially impairs the ability to act as an EMA
options.textZh: 实质损害其 EMA 执业能力的酒精或药物成瘾

options.textEn: Incompetently carrying out the duties of an EMA
options.textZh: 不胜任地履行 EMA 职责

questions.explanationEn: s.7(1)(c) requires that the physical ailment, emotional disturbance or addiction 'materially impairs' the person's ability to act as an EMA. A condition that does not materially impair ability is not a ground. The other options track s.7(1)(a), (b) and (c) directly.
questions.explanationZh: s.7(1)(c) 要求身体疾病、情绪障碍或成瘾必须'实质损害'（materially impairs）其 EMA 执业能力。不构成实质损害的健康状况不是处分事由。其余选项分别对应 s.7(1)(a)、(b)、(c)。

questions.questionEn: Which sanction is NOT available to the licensing board after a disciplinary determination under s.7?
questions.questionZh: 依 s.7 作出纪律认定后，下列哪项处分是 licensing board 无权作出的？

options.textEn: Imposing conditions on the licence
options.textZh: 对 licence 施加条件

options.textEn: Suspending or revoking the licence
options.textZh: 暂停或吊销 licence

options.textEn: Imposing a monetary fine
options.textZh: 处以罚款

options.textEn: Barring the person from being licensed for a period
options.textZh: 在一定期限内禁止其获得 licence

questions.explanationEn: s.7(3) lists the board's powers: impose conditions on the licence; suspend the licence; revoke the licence; bar the person from being licensed for a period. Fines and imprisonment are not among them.
questions.explanationZh: s.7(3) 列出的 Board 权力为：对 licence 施加条件；暂停 licence；吊销 licence；在一定期限内禁止其获得 licence。罚款和监禁不在其列。

questions.questionEn: Before making a disciplinary determination under s.7 of the EHS Act, the licensing board must:
questions.questionZh: 依 EHS Act s.7 作出纪律认定之前，licensing board 必须：

options.textEn: Refer the matter to the police
options.textZh: 将案件移交警方

options.textEn: Hold a hearing (whether acting on a complaint or on its own motion)
options.textZh: 举行听证（无论是基于投诉还是主动立案）

options.textEn: Obtain the minister's written approval
options.textZh: 取得厅长书面批准

options.textEn: Wait for the EMA's licence to expire
options.textZh: 等 EMA 的 licence 到期

questions.explanationEn: s.7(1): 'On receipt of a complaint or on its own motion and after a hearing, the licensing board may determine...'. The hearing is a statutory precondition; specified provisions of the Administrative Tribunals Act apply to it (s.7(2)).
questions.explanationZh: s.7(1)：'在接到投诉或主动立案、并经听证（hearing）后，licensing board 方可认定……'。听证是法定前置程序；听证适用 Administrative Tribunals Act 的特定条款（s.7(2)）。

questions.questionEn: During an ongoing investigation, and before any hearing, may the licensing board suspend an EMA's licence?
questions.questionZh: 调查进行中、听证尚未举行时，licensing board 可以暂停 EMA 的 licence 吗？

options.textEn: Yes, but only with a court order
options.textZh: 可以，但必须有法院命令

options.textEn: No — a licence can only be suspended after a full hearing
options.textZh: 不行——licence 只能在完整听证后才能暂停

options.textEn: Yes — under s.8, if it considers the action necessary to protect the public, it may set limits or conditions on practice or suspend the licence
options.textZh: 可以——依 s.8，如认为保护公众有必要，可对执业设限、附加条件，或暂停 licence

options.textEn: Only if the EMA consents
options.textZh: 只有 EMA 本人同意才行

questions.explanationEn: EHS Act s.8(1): if the licensing board considers the action necessary to protect the public during an investigation or until a hearing, it may set limits or conditions on the EMA's practice or suspend the licence. It must then notify the EMA in writing of the decision, reasons and appeal right (s.8(2)), and must cancel the action when no longer necessary (s.8(4)).
questions.explanationZh: EHS Act s.8(1)：在调查期间或听证之前，如 Board 认为保护公众有必要，可对该 EMA 的执业设限、附加条件，或暂停其 licence。之后必须书面通知 EMA 决定、理由和上诉权（s.8(2)）；当措施不再必要时必须撤销（s.8(4)）。

questions.questionEn: The licensing board mails an extraordinary-action suspension notice to an EMA's registered address. When does the decision take effect?
questions.questionZh: licensing board 将依 s.8 作出的暂停执照通知邮寄至 EMA 的注册地址。该决定何时生效？

options.textEn: Only once the EMA signs an acknowledgment
options.textZh: EMA 签收确认后才生效

options.textEn: Immediately when the board votes
options.textZh: Board 表决通过时立即生效

options.textEn: 30 days after mailing
options.textZh: 寄出后 30 天

options.textEn: On the earlier of the EMA receiving the notice, or 3 days after it is mailed to the registered address
options.textZh: 取两者较早者：EMA 收到通知之时，或通知寄往注册地址后 3 天

questions.explanationEn: s.8(3): a decision under s.8(1) is not effective until the earlier of (a) the time the EMA receives the notice, and (b) 3 days after the notice is mailed to the last address recorded in the register.
questions.explanationZh: s.8(3)：s.8(1) 的决定在下列较早时点前不生效：(a) EMA 收到通知之时；(b) 通知按 register 中最后记录的地址寄出后 3 天。

questions.questionEn: An EMA wishes to appeal a disciplinary determination of the licensing board. Where and within what time must the appeal be brought?
questions.questionZh: EMA 想对 licensing board 的纪律认定提出上诉。应向哪里、在多长时间内提出？

options.textEn: To the Minister of Health, within 60 days
options.textZh: 向卫生厅长，60 天内

options.textEn: To the BC Supreme Court, within 30 days after the determination or disciplinary action
options.textZh: 向 BC 最高法院（Supreme Court），在认定或处分作出后 30 天内

options.textEn: To the Health Professions Review Board, within 90 days
options.textZh: 向 Health Professions Review Board，90 天内

options.textEn: To the Ombudsperson, within 14 days
options.textZh: 向 Ombudsperson，14 天内

questions.explanationEn: EHS Act s.9(1): a person aggrieved by a determination or disciplinary action under s.7 may appeal to the Supreme Court within 30 days. The court may confirm, reverse or vary the decision, or refer it back to the board (s.9(6)). The same appeal route applies to extraordinary action under s.8 (s.8(5)).
questions.explanationZh: EHS Act s.9(1)：对 s.7 的认定或纪律处分不服者，可在 30 天内向最高法院上诉。法院可维持、推翻或变更决定，或发回 Board（s.9(6)）。对 s.8 特别措施的上诉走同一途径（s.8(5)）。

questions.questionEn: An EMA is notified that their licence has been revoked. Within what time must they return the licence to the licensing board?
questions.questionZh: EMA 接到 licence 被吊销的通知。必须在多长时间内把 licence 交回 licensing board？

options.textEn: Within 48 hours
options.textZh: 48 小时内

options.textEn: Within 24 hours
options.textZh: 24 小时内

options.textEn: Within 7 days
options.textZh: 7 天内

options.textEn: Within 30 days
options.textZh: 30 天内

questions.explanationEn: EMA Regulation s.12: if a licence expires or is suspended or revoked, the EMA must return the licence to the licensing board within 48 hours after expiration or after being notified of the suspension or revocation.
questions.explanationZh: EMA Regulation s.12：licence 到期、被暂停或被吊销时，EMA 必须在到期后或接到暂停/吊销通知后 48 小时内将 licence 交回 licensing board。

questions.questionEn: During a public health emergency, may an EMA whose licence is suspended under the Act provide services under an emergency order?
questions.questionZh: 公共卫生紧急状态期间，licence 已被依 Act 暂停的 EMA 可以依 emergency order 提供服务吗？

options.textEn: Only under direct physician supervision
options.textZh: 只能在医生直接监督下

options.textEn: Yes, if their employer approves
options.textZh: 可以，只要雇主批准

options.textEn: No — a person whose licence is suspended under s.7(3) or s.8(1) of the Act must not act under an emergency order
options.textZh: 不可以——licence 被依 Act s.7(3) 或 s.8(1) 暂停的人不得依 emergency order 行事

options.textEn: Yes — emergency orders override suspensions
options.textZh: 可以——emergency order 优先于暂停处分

questions.explanationEn: EMA Regulation s.37(2)(a): a person must not perform an activity or provide a service under an emergency order if they are an EMA whose licence is suspended under s.7(3) or s.8(1) of the Act. The same applies to persons suspended for similar reasons in other jurisdictions (s.37(2)(b)).
questions.explanationZh: EMA Regulation s.37(2)(a)：licence 被依 Act s.7(3) 或 s.8(1) 暂停的 EMA 不得依 emergency order 从事任何活动或提供服务。因类似原因在其他管辖区被暂停者同样禁止（s.37(2)(b)）。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following is NOT required to be set out in the register of EMAs under s.13(1) of the EMA Regulation?
questions.questionZh: 依 EMA Regulation s.13(1)，下列哪项不是 register（注册簿）必须记载的内容？

options.textEn: The category of licence and any endorsements
options.textZh: 持牌类别及任何 endorsement

options.textEn: The EMA's examination scores
options.textZh: EMA 的考试分数

options.textEn: A notation of each renewal, suspension or revocation of the licence
options.textZh: 每次续牌、暂停或吊销的记载

options.textEn: The EMA's name, address, licence number and place of employment
options.textZh: EMA 的姓名、地址、licence 编号和工作单位

questions.explanationEn: s.13(1) requires the register to set out name, address, licence number and place of employment; category and endorsements; terms, limits or conditions imposed by the board; and notations of renewals, suspensions and revocations (plus anything else the board considers necessary). Exam scores are not a required register entry.
questions.explanationZh: s.13(1) 要求 register 记载：姓名、地址、licence 编号、工作单位；类别及 endorsement；Board 施加的条款、限制或条件；续牌、暂停、吊销的记载（以及 Board 认为必要的其他信息）。考试分数不是法定记载事项。

questions.questionEn: An EMA moves to a new home and starts at a new ambulance station. What does the EMA Regulation require?
questions.questionZh: 某 EMA 搬了新家并调到新的救护站工作。EMA Regulation 对此有什么要求？

options.textEn: Notify the licensing board verbally within 90 days
options.textZh: 90 天内口头通知 licensing board

options.textEn: Notify only the employer
options.textZh: 只需通知雇主

options.textEn: No notification is needed until renewal
options.textZh: 续牌前无需通知

options.textEn: Notify the licensing board in writing within 30 days of the change
options.textZh: 在变更后 30 天内以书面形式通知 licensing board

questions.explanationEn: s.13(2): an EMA must notify the licensing board, in writing, of any change of name, address or place of employment within 30 days after the change, and the change must be entered in the register.
questions.explanationZh: s.13(2)：EMA 的姓名、地址或工作单位发生任何变更后，必须在 30 天内以书面形式通知 licensing board，变更须登入 register。

questions.questionEn: Which statement about public access to the register of EMAs is correct?
questions.questionZh: 关于公众查阅 EMA register 的规定，下列哪项正确？

options.textEn: The board must make register information publicly accessible free of charge, but may withhold information whose disclosure could threaten an EMA's safety
options.textZh: Board 必须让公众免费查阅 register 信息，但如披露可能危及某 EMA 的人身安全，可不予披露

options.textEn: The register is confidential and never disclosed
options.textZh: register 是保密的，从不披露

options.textEn: Access requires a paid subscription
options.textZh: 查阅需要付费订阅

options.textEn: Only employers may access the register
options.textZh: 只有雇主可以查阅

questions.explanationEn: s.14(1)-(2): the licensing board must make register information publicly accessible free of charge; if disclosure could threaten the safety of an EMA, the board may refuse to disclose all or part of the information or respond only verbally to requests.
questions.explanationZh: s.14(1)-(2)：licensing board 必须让公众免费查阅 register 信息；如披露可能危及某 EMA 的安全，Board 可拒绝披露全部或部分信息，或仅以口头方式回应查询。

questions.questionEn: How long must an EMA retain supporting documentation for continuing education credits and patient contacts claimed in a reporting period?
questions.questionZh: EMA 申报的继续教育学分和患者接触的支持文件必须保存多久？

options.textEn: Until the report is accepted
options.textZh: 到申报被接受为止

options.textEn: 1 year after submission
options.textZh: 提交后 1 年

options.textEn: At least 3 years after the last day of the reporting period
options.textZh: 报告周期最后一天之后至少 3 年

options.textEn: At least 10 years
options.textZh: 至少 10 年

questions.explanationEn: s.23(1): an EMA must retain adequate supporting documentation during each reporting period and for at least 3 years after the last day of each reporting period, and must provide it to the director on request (s.23(2)).
questions.explanationZh: s.23(1)：EMA 必须在每个报告周期内及其最后一天之后至少 3 年内保存充分的支持文件，并应 director 要求出示（s.23(2)）。

questions.questionEn: How must continuing competence information (CE credits and patient contacts) be submitted to the director?
questions.questionZh: 继续能力信息（CE 学分和患者接触）必须以什么方式提交给 director？

options.textEn: Through the EMA's employer
options.textZh: 通过 EMA 的雇主转交

options.textEn: By registered mail only
options.textZh: 只能挂号信邮寄

options.textEn: In person at a Service BC office
options.textZh: 到 Service BC 办事处当面提交

options.textEn: Electronically, using the website established and maintained by the ministry
options.textZh: 通过卫生厅建立和维护的网站以电子方式提交

questions.explanationEn: s.22: information required under s.21(1) or (2) must be submitted electronically using the website established and maintained by the ministry for the purposes of this section.
questions.explanationZh: s.22：依 s.21(1) 或 (2) 要求的信息必须通过卫生厅为此设立和维护的网站以电子方式提交。

questions.questionEn: Under an emergency order made during a public health emergency, the provincial health officer may impose which documentation duty on authorized persons?
questions.questionZh: 公共卫生紧急状态期间发布的 emergency order 中，省卫生官可对获授权人员施加哪项文书义务？

options.textEn: A requirement to destroy all records after the emergency
options.textZh: 要求紧急状态结束后销毁所有记录

options.textEn: A requirement to publish patient records online
options.textZh: 要求在网上公开患者记录

options.textEn: None — emergency orders cannot address records
options.textZh: 无——emergency order 不能涉及记录事项

options.textEn: A requirement to keep records or make reports in respect of matters relevant to the order
options.textZh: 要求就与命令相关的事项保存记录或提交报告

questions.explanationEn: s.33(e): for the purposes of an emergency order, the provincial health officer may require authorized persons to keep records or make reports in respect of matters relevant to the order, including reports to the PHO, a medical health officer, the minister, the corporation or the licensing board.
questions.explanationZh: s.33(e)：为实施 emergency order，省卫生官可要求获授权人员就与命令相关的事项保存记录或提交报告，报告对象可包括省卫生官、medical health officer、厅长、corporation 或 licensing board。

questions.questionEn: An EMA has reasonable grounds to believe a patient made an advance directive refusing resuscitation. Under the Emergency Health Services Act, the EMA:
questions.questionZh: EMA 有合理理由相信患者已作出拒绝心肺复苏的 advance directive（预先指示）。依 Emergency Health Services Act，该 EMA：

options.textEn: Must provide the service anyway because it is life-saving
options.textZh: 因为是救命措施，仍必须提供该服务

options.textEn: May provide the service if family members consent
options.textZh: 家属同意即可提供

options.textEn: Must not provide the service the directive refuses
options.textZh: 不得提供该指示所拒绝的服务

options.textEn: Must wait for a court order
options.textZh: 必须等法院命令

questions.explanationEn: EHS Act s.11.1: an EMA must not provide a service in respect of a person if the EMA has reasonable grounds to believe the person has made an advance directive (as defined in the Health Care (Consent) and Care Facility (Admission) Act) refusing consent to that service.
questions.explanationZh: EHS Act s.11.1：如 EMA 有合理理由相信患者已作出拒绝同意某项服务的 advance directive（定义见 Health Care (Consent) and Care Facility (Admission) Act），则不得提供该服务。

questions.questionEn: For the purposes of s.11.1 of the EHS Act, 'advance directive' takes its definition from which statute?
questions.questionZh: 就 EHS Act s.11.1 而言，'advance directive' 的定义来自哪部法律？

options.textEn: The Public Health Act
options.textZh: Public Health Act

options.textEn: The Health Professions and Occupations Act
options.textZh: Health Professions and Occupations Act

options.textEn: The Health Care (Consent) and Care Facility (Admission) Act
options.textZh: Health Care (Consent) and Care Facility (Admission) Act

options.textEn: The Representation Agreement Act
options.textZh: Representation Agreement Act

questions.explanationEn: s.11.1 expressly adopts the definition of 'advance directive' from the Health Care (Consent) and Care Facility (Admission) Act. The EHS Act also borrows its definition of 'health care' from the same statute (s.1).
questions.explanationZh: s.11.1 明确采用 Health Care (Consent) and Care Facility (Admission) Act 中 'advance directive' 的定义。EHS Act 的 'health care' 定义也来自同一部法律（s.1）。

questions.questionEn: Under the Code of Ethics, the EMA's duty to preserve the confidence of patient information is qualified by what?
questions.questionZh: 依 Code of Ethics，EMA 为患者信息保密的义务受什么限定？

options.textEn: It can be waived by the employer
options.textZh: 雇主可予以豁免

options.textEn: It must be consistent with the duty to act at all times for the patient's well-being
options.textZh: 须与始终为患者福祉行动的义务相一致

options.textEn: It is absolute — no disclosure is ever permitted
options.textZh: 绝对保密——任何情况下都不得披露

options.textEn: It applies only while on duty
options.textZh: 只在当班期间适用

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 3(d): EMAs must 'preserve the confidence of patient information consistent with the duty to act at all times for the patient's well-being'. Clinically necessary disclosure — such as handover to the receiving care team — is consistent with that duty; gratuitous disclosure is not.
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 3(d)：EMA 必须'保守患者信息的机密，同时符合始终为患者福祉行动的义务'。临床必要的披露（如向接收团队交接）符合该义务；无必要的泄露则违反。

questions.questionEn: An endorsed EMA FR is assisting a patient with the patient's own prescribed nitroglycerin. Which of the following is a REQUIRED condition under Schedule 2, s.1(h)?
questions.questionZh: 取得 endorsement 的 EMA FR 协助患者使用其自备的处方硝酸甘油。依 Schedule 2 s.1(h)，下列哪项是必须满足的条件？

options.textEn: A physician must be physically present
options.textZh: 必须有医生亲自在场

options.textEn: The patient's family must sign a consent form
options.textZh: 患者家属必须签署同意书

options.textEn: The medication must be administered intravenously
options.textZh: 药物必须经静脉给予

options.textEn: The patient must have requested the EMA's assistance with the medication
options.textZh: 必须是患者本人请求 EMA 协助用药

questions.explanationEn: Schedule 2, s.1(h) conditions: for prescription-only medications, the medication must already have been prescribed to the patient; the patient must have requested the assistance; the administration must relate to the emergency services being provided; the medication must be administered as prescribed; and the patient must not be being transported between health facilities.
questions.explanationZh: Schedule 2 s.1(h) 的条件：处方药必须已由医疗专业人员开给该患者；患者本人请求协助；给药与正在提供的紧急服务相关；按处方给药；且患者不在医疗机构之间转运途中。

questions.questionEn: Under s.5.6 of the EHS Act, what personal information about a current or former EMA may the minister agree to release to another jurisdiction's regulator?
questions.questionZh: 依 EHS Act s.5.6，厅长可同意向其他管辖区的监管机构披露现任或前任 EMA 的哪些个人信息？

options.textEn: None — regulator-to-regulator sharing is prohibited
options.textZh: 任何信息都不行——监管机构之间禁止共享

options.textEn: Only the EMA's name and licence number
options.textZh: 只能披露姓名和 licence 编号

options.textEn: Information including practice restrictions, complaints, competency and discipline, under an information-sharing agreement
options.textZh: 依信息共享协议，可披露包括执业限制、投诉、能力和纪律处分在内的信息

options.textEn: Only information the EMA approves in writing
options.textZh: 只能披露 EMA 书面同意的信息

questions.explanationEn: s.5.6(2)(b): the minister may enter information-sharing agreements (as defined in FOIPPA s.69(1)) to allow release to a governing body of personal information respecting a current or former EMA, including information about practice restrictions, complaints, competency or discipline — supporting labour mobility and interjurisdictional regulation.
questions.explanationZh: s.5.6(2)(b)：厅长可签订信息共享协议（定义见 FOIPPA s.69(1)），允许向其他管辖区的监管机构披露现任或前任 EMA 的个人信息，包括执业限制、投诉、能力和纪律处分记录——以支持劳动力流动与跨区监管。

questions.questionEn: Who must establish the release protocol that EMAs use to determine when an assessed person is not transported (or transported somewhere other than a facility)?
questions.questionZh: EMA 用来判断经评估患者不予转运（或转运至医疗机构以外地点）的 release protocol 由谁制定？

options.textEn: The licensing board
options.textZh: licensing board

options.textEn: The corporation (BCEHS)
options.textZh: corporation（BCEHS）

options.textEn: Each EMA individually, based on clinical judgment
options.textZh: 各 EMA 凭临床判断自行制定

options.textEn: The receiving hospital
options.textZh: 接收医院

questions.explanationEn: EMA Regulation s.28(1): the corporation must establish the protocol used by an EMA responding to a request for ambulance services to determine when an assessed person is to be transported to a place other than a facility or not transported. Its use is restricted to EMAs employed by the corporation or by organizations with the corporation's written consent (s.28(2)).
questions.explanationZh: EMA Regulation s.28(1)：corporation 必须制定该 protocol，供响应救护请求的 EMA 判断经评估患者应转运至医疗机构以外的地点还是不予转运。该 protocol 仅限 corporation 雇员或经 corporation 书面同意的机构雇员使用（s.28(2)）。

questions.questionEn: What is the term of a PCP licence, and of an EMA FR licence?
questions.questionZh: PCP licence 和 EMA FR licence 的有效期分别是多久？

options.textEn: Both: 5 years
options.textZh: 都是 5 年

options.textEn: PCP: 3 years; EMA FR: 1 year
options.textZh: PCP：3 年；EMA FR：1 年

options.textEn: PCP: 5 years; EMA FR: 3 years
options.textZh: PCP：5 年；EMA FR：3 年

options.textEn: PCP: 10 years; EMA FR: 5 years
options.textZh: PCP：10 年；EMA FR：5 年

questions.explanationEn: s.9(1): licences in the EMR, PCP, ACP, CCP and ITT categories expire 5 years after issue or renewal; an EMA FR licence expires 3 years after issue or renewal (or on voluntary relinquishment, whichever is earlier). The Exam Guidelines add that EMR and PCP licences require yearly continuing competence submissions during the 5-year term.
questions.explanationZh: s.9(1)：EMR、PCP、ACP、CCP、ITT 类别的 licence 自签发或续期起 5 年到期；EMA FR licence 为 3 年（如提前自愿放弃则以放弃日为准）。考试指南补充：EMR 和 PCP 在 5 年有效期内每年都要提交继续能力申报。
questions.sourceRef: EMA Regulation s.9(1); BC Exam Guidelines p.92

questions.questionEn: An EMA cannot complete a renewal requirement before their licence expires due to special circumstances. What may the licensing board do?
questions.questionZh: 某 EMA 因特殊情况无法在 licence 到期前完成续牌要求。licensing board 可以怎么做？

options.textEn: Extend the licence, before it expires, for up to 60 days
options.textZh: 在到期前将 licence 延长最多 60 天

options.textEn: Issue a new licence without any requirements
options.textZh: 免除所有要求直接发新 licence

options.textEn: Nothing — the licence must lapse
options.textZh: 无能为力——licence 只能失效

options.textEn: Extend the licence for up to 1 year
options.textZh: 将 licence 延长最多 1 年

questions.explanationEn: s.9(2): the board may, prior to the expiry date, extend the licence for a period not longer than 60 days if satisfied that special circumstances exist such that the EMA will be unable to complete a renewal requirement before expiry.
questions.explanationZh: s.9(2)：如 Board 确信存在特殊情况使 EMA 无法在到期前完成续牌要求，可在到期日之前将 licence 延长不超过 60 天。

questions.questionEn: In each reporting period, what are the continuing competence requirements for a licensed PCP under s.17 of the EMA Regulation?
questions.questionZh: 依 EMA Regulation s.17，持牌 PCP 每个报告周期的继续能力要求是什么？

options.textEn: Rewriting the jurisprudence exam annually
options.textZh: 每年重考 jurisprudence 考试

options.textEn: At least 50 patient contacts only
options.textZh: 只需至少 50 次患者接触

options.textEn: At least 20 continuing education credits AND at least 20 patient contacts (excess CE credits can substitute one-to-one for missing contacts)
options.textZh: 至少 20 个继续教育学分，且至少 20 次患者接触（超额 CE 学分可按一比一抵扣不足的患者接触）

options.textEn: At least 40 continuing education credits only
options.textZh: 只需至少 40 个继续教育学分

questions.explanationEn: s.17(1): accumulate at least 20 CE credits and have at least 20 patient contacts (or 20 minus the additional CE credits substituted under s.17(3), which allows excess credits over 20 to replace patient contacts one-to-one).
questions.explanationZh: s.17(1)：累积至少 20 个 CE 学分，并有至少 20 次患者接触（或依 s.17(3)，超过 20 的多余学分可按一比一抵扣患者接触，使接触次数相应减少）。

questions.questionEn: The continuing competence requirements in Part 4 of the EMA Regulation do NOT apply to which licence holders?
questions.questionZh: EMA Regulation Part 4 的继续能力要求不适用于哪些持牌人？

options.textEn: PCPs employed part-time
options.textZh: 兼职受雇的 PCP

options.textEn: EMAs holding an EMA FR licence or a licence issued under ss.4-7 (short term, student, temporary, Washington State)
options.textZh: 持 EMA FR licence，或持依 ss.4-7 签发的 licence（短期、学生、临时、华盛顿州）的 EMA

options.textEn: EMAs over the age of 60
options.textZh: 60 岁以上的 EMA

options.textEn: ACPs and CCPs
options.textZh: ACP 和 CCP

questions.explanationEn: s.16: Part 4 does not apply to an EMA holding a licence in the EMA FR category or a licence issued under ss.4-7 of the regulation. EMA FR renewal instead requires passing any examination required by the board (s.9.1).
questions.explanationZh: s.16：Part 4 不适用于持 EMA FR 类别 licence 或持依本法规 ss.4-7 签发的 licence 的 EMA。EMA FR 的续牌要求是：通过 Board 要求的任何考试（s.9.1）。

questions.questionEn: A PCP was first licensed 8 months before the end of the current reporting period. Do the continuing competence and reporting requirements apply for that period?
questions.questionZh: 某 PCP 在当前报告周期结束前 8 个月才首次获牌。该周期的继续能力和申报要求适用于他吗？

options.textEn: No — ss.17 and 20 do not apply if the licence was issued not more than one year before the last day of the reporting period
options.textZh: 不适用——licence 签发距报告周期最后一天不超过一年的，免除 ss.17 和 20 的要求

options.textEn: Yes — requirements apply from the first day of licensure
options.textZh: 适用——从获牌第一天起就有要求

options.textEn: Yes, but at half the normal amounts
options.textZh: 适用，但要求减半

options.textEn: Only the patient contact requirement applies
options.textZh: 只适用患者接触要求

questions.explanationEn: s.19(1): if an EMA's licence was issued not more than one year before the last day of a reporting period, ss.17 (requirements) and 20 (reporting) do not apply in respect of that reporting period.
questions.explanationZh: s.19(1)：licence 签发距某报告周期最后一天不超过一年的，该周期免除 s.17（能力要求）和 s.20（申报）的适用。

questions.questionEn: What is the reporting period for continuing competence, and by when must the annual report be submitted?
questions.questionZh: 继续能力的报告周期是什么？年度申报最迟何时提交？

options.textEn: July 1 to June 30; report by July 15
options.textZh: 7 月 1 日至次年 6 月 30 日；7 月 15 日前申报

options.textEn: The EMA's licence anniversary date each year
options.textZh: 每年 licence 周年日

options.textEn: April 1 to March 31; report no later than April 30
options.textZh: 4 月 1 日至次年 3 月 31 日；最迟 4 月 30 日申报

options.textEn: January 1 to December 31; report by January 31
options.textZh: 1 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日；1 月 31 日前申报

questions.explanationEn: s.15 defines the reporting period as April 1 to March 31 of the following year; s.20 requires the EMA to submit the information no later than April 30 in each year for the reporting period that has just ended.
questions.explanationZh: s.15 将报告周期定义为 4 月 1 日至次年 3 月 31 日；s.20 要求 EMA 每年最迟 4 月 30 日就刚结束的报告周期提交申报信息。

questions.questionEn: After adjudication, the director still finds an EMA failed to meet continuing competence requirements and requires an evaluating written examination. How many attempts does the EMA get?
questions.questionZh: 仲裁后 director 仍认定某 EMA 未达继续能力要求，并要求其参加书面评估考试。该 EMA 有几次考试机会？

options.textEn: Three attempts at the written examination
options.textZh: 笔试有三次机会

options.textEn: One attempt only; failing it may lead to a practical examination with up to 3 attempts
options.textZh: 只有一次；笔试不过可被要求参加实操评估考试，实操最多 3 次

options.textEn: Two attempts, then automatic revocation
options.textZh: 两次，之后自动吊销

options.textEn: Unlimited attempts within 12 months
options.textZh: 12 个月内不限次数

questions.explanationEn: s.26(2): the written evaluating examination may be attempted on one occasion only. If failed, the director may require a practical examination (s.26(3)), which may be attempted on no more than 3 occasions (s.26(4)). Failing the practical can lead to consideration of terms and conditions on the licence under s.6(5)(b) of the Act (s.26(5)).
questions.explanationZh: s.26(2)：书面评估考试只能参加一次。不及格时 director 可要求参加实操评估考试（s.26(3)），实操最多 3 次（s.26(4)）。实操仍不过，可依 Act s.6(5)(b) 考虑对 licence 施加条款和条件（s.26(5)）。

questions.questionEn: A former EMA's licence expired two years ago. Under what conditions may the licensing board reinstate it?
questions.questionZh: 某前 EMA 的 licence 已过期两年。licensing board 在什么条件下可以为其复牌？

options.textEn: Only by order of the Supreme Court
options.textZh: 只能由最高法院下令

options.textEn: If reinstatement would not constitute an undue risk to public health or safety, and the former EMA completes any training or written, oral or practical examinations required by the board
options.textZh: 如复牌不会对公众健康或安全构成不当风险，且该前 EMA 完成 Board 要求的培训或笔试/口试/实操考试

options.textEn: Automatically upon payment of the renewal fee
options.textZh: 缴纳续牌费后自动复牌

options.textEn: Reinstatement is impossible after expiry — a new application is always required
options.textZh: 过期后不可能复牌——必须完全重新申请

questions.explanationEn: s.9.2: the board may reinstate the licence of a former EMA whose licence has expired if (a) reinstatement would not constitute an undue risk to public health or safety, and (b) the former EMA successfully completes any training or written, oral or practical examinations the board requires.
questions.explanationZh: s.9.2：前 EMA 的 licence 已过期时，如 (a) 复牌不会对公众健康或安全构成不当风险，且 (b) 本人成功完成 Board 要求的培训或笔试/口试/实操考试，Board 可为其复牌。

questions.questionEn: For continuing competence purposes, a patient contact counts toward the s.17 requirement only if:
questions.questionZh: 就继续能力而言，一次患者接触要计入 s.17 的要求，必须满足什么条件？

options.textEn: It occurred while on an ambulance
options.textZh: 发生在救护车上

options.textEn: The patient was transported to hospital
options.textZh: 患者被转运到了医院

options.textEn: It lasted at least 30 minutes
options.textZh: 持续至少 30 分钟

options.textEn: The director is satisfied the EMA provided full patient assessment or direct patient care during the contact
options.textZh: director 确信 EMA 在该次接触中提供了完整患者评估或直接患者照护

questions.explanationEn: s.17(2)(b): a patient contact meets the requirement only if the director is satisfied that the EMA provided full patient assessment or direct patient care to the patient during the contact. 'Patient contact' means a contact with a patient in the course of practising the profession (s.15).
questions.explanationZh: s.17(2)(b)：只有 director 确信 EMA 在接触中为患者提供了完整评估或直接照护，该次患者接触才算达标。'Patient contact' 的定义是执业过程中与患者的接触（s.15）。
